## What

One paragraph: what changed and why.

## Checks

- [ ] `cd open-stanley && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] No private material (vault files, posts, comments, names, meeting content)
- [ ] If a rule or skill changed: fixture or eval added, CHANGELOG line written
- [ ] If anything public changed (counts, install, landing promises): `open-stanley/docs/claims.yml` updated first
